name: Prompt Director
tagline: Breaks an image or video brief into prompt pieces across six creative desks
description: A director bot that runs a team of six specialist desks (figure, narrative, camera, light, background, fashion) to break image and video prompts into sections and assemble them into clean, copyable prompts. For AI art and video creators who want a sharper prompt structure.
author: KittyTellesWolf
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
